#Salvation
#JesusIsLord
#BiblicalTruth
#ChristianPosts
#FaithInJesus
#beready

If Jesus returned tonight…
would you be ready?
What do you think? Be honest. 🙏
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: If the Bible is true…
paragraphs:
If the Bible is true…
ignoring God is the most dangerous decision a person can make.

Not rejecting Him.
Not mocking Him.
Just ignoring Him.
Because one day, every person will stand before God.
Hebrews 9:27.
Let’s be honest.

Most people don’t hate God.
They just ignore Him.
But if the Bible is true…
that might be the most dangerous decision a person can make.
What do you think?
Most people don’t reject God.
They just ignore Him.
Do you think that’s more dangerous? 👀
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Your story is not over.
paragraphs:
Your story is not over.
God is still writing it.
Jeremiah 29:11
Some chapters of life feel confusing.

Doors close.
Prayers seem unanswered.
The future feels uncertain.
But God is not finished with your story.

Even in seasons you don't understand,
He is still working behind the scenes.

You are not forgotten.
You are part of His plan.
"For I know the plans I have for you," declares the Lord… — Jeremiah 29:11
If this reminded you of God’s promise,
Who needed this reminder today?
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Everyone bowed.
paragraphs:
Everyone bowed.
Three men didn’t.

Not because it was easy.
Because they had already decided who they belonged to.
What is one thing you refuse to bow to?

The crowd bowed.
The music played.
The pressure was real.
But conviction was stronger.
They said no.

Sometimes faith isn’t loud.
It’s just the quiet strength to stand when everyone else folds.

Three men.
One decision.
They said no.
Daniel 3:16–18

Pressure reveals what we already decided in private.
What’s one value you won’t compromise? 👇
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Partial obedience still protects something God asked you to surrender.
paragraphs: Partial obedience still protects something God asked you to surrender.

King Saul didn’t deny God.
He adjusted Him.

He kept what looked valuable.
He called it worship.
He justified it with good intentions.
But heaven measures obedience differently.
“To obey is better than sacrifice.” – 1 Samuel 15:22

The question isn’t:
“Did I mean well?”

The question is:
“Did I obey fully?”
Does intention matter more than execution?

Is partial obedience still disobedience?
Or does God honor the heart behind it?
Let’s talk.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Nicodemus wasn’t ignorant.
paragraphs: Nicodemus wasn’t ignorant.
He was one of the most educated Bible teachers in Israel.

He knew the Scriptures.
He taught others.
He defended truth.
Yet Jesus told him something shocking:
“You must be born again.”
This reveals a sobering truth:

You can know the Bible
and still not experience the life it points to.

Knowledge fills the mind.
But new birth transforms the heart.
The real question is not:
“Do I know Scripture?”
But:
“Has the Spirit made me new?”
📖 John 3:3
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: The Bible says all have sinned.
paragraphs:
The Bible says all have sinned.
Not some. Not most. All.

If sin is real… forgiveness isn’t optional.
It’s the only hope we have.
And that forgiveness has a name: Jesus Christ.
Romans 3:23–24
Let’s be honest.

If sin is actually real…
then nobody walks away innocent.
That means every one of us needs forgiveness.

The real question is:
Where are you looking for it?
If sin exists… do you believe everyone needs forgiveness?
Or do you think people are basically good? 👀
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: You think your past disqualified you.
paragraphs: You think your past disqualified you.

The mistakes.
The bad decisions.
The years you feel you wasted.
But God specializes in restoration stories.
The Bible says:
📖 “I will restore to you the years the locusts have eaten.” — Joel 2:25

That means the years you regret…
God can still redeem.
Nothing in your story is beyond His power.
Your failure is not your final chapter.
🔥 Your restoration may be just beginning.
If you believe God can restore broken seasons, comment RESTORE.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Jesus didn’t come for perfect people.
paragraphs: Jesus didn’t come for perfect people.
He came for the ones who feel too broken to be loved.

For the sinner.
For the ashamed.
For the one who thinks their past disqualified them.
The truth is…
Your brokenness doesn’t scare Jesus.
It’s the very reason He came.
If you feel unworthy today, remember this:
You are not rejected.
You are the kind of person Jesus came to rescue.

His grace is bigger than your past.
His mercy is deeper than your shame.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: One man had everything.
paragraphs:
One man had everything.
One man left everything.
The rich ruler walked away from Jesus grieving.
Peter walked toward the cross.
The difference wasn’t money.
It was surrender.
Jesus doesn’t ask everyone to sell everything.
But He will ask for whatever owns your heart.

Sometimes that’s money.
Sometimes reputation.
Sometimes control.
The real question is simple:
What are we unwilling to surrender?
📖 Mark 10:21
Before scrolling, ask yourself honestly:
If Jesus asked for it… would I let it go?
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: If Jesus is truly the Son of God, His words are not suggestions.
paragraphs: If Jesus is truly the Son of God, His words are not suggestions.

They are truth.
They are life.
They are judgment.
You cannot ignore Him and still claim Him.
John 14:6 isn’t popular—but it’s clear.
Let’s be honest.

Most people say they believe in Jesus…
but ignore half of what He said.
If He really is the Son of God, that’s not just disagreement.
That’s rejection.

Do people believe in Jesus…
or just the version of Him they prefer?
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Fear will always try to convince you that the storm is too strong and the step is too risky.
paragraphs: Fear will always try to convince you that the storm is too strong and the step is too risky.
But the same God who called Peter out of the boat is the same God walking with you today.
Sometimes the miracle doesn’t happen until you step.
“Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.” — Matthew 14:29
What step of faith do you feel God calling you to take right now? 👇
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Your identity is not defined by your worst moments.
paragraphs: Your identity is not defined by your worst moments.

Not by the mistakes you regret.
Not by the anxiety you battle.
Not by the failures you remember.
Your identity is found in Jesus.

Through Him, you are forgiven.
Through Him, you are redeemed.
Through Him, you are chosen and deeply loved.
"In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins." — Ephesians 1:7
Save this reminder for the days when you forget who you are in Christ.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Before God lifts you…
paragraphs:
Before God lifts you…
what if He’s building the strength to carry it?

Some people want elevation.
Others are willing to kneel first.
Which one are you becoming?

The world rewards noise.
God rewards posture.
Humble. Then elevated.

We all want the “suddenly.”
But 1 Peter 5 says the order is different.

Lower yourself.
Trust His timing.
Then He lifts you.

Promotion without formation breaks people.
Formation first builds capacity.
Come back to this.
“Elevation reveals what humility built.”
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Moses served God faithfully for 40 years.
paragraphs: Moses served God faithfully for 40 years.

He confronted Pharaoh.
He parted the sea.
He carried Israel through the wilderness.
Yet he never stepped into the Promised Land.
One act of disobedience changed the outcome.

Faithful service is powerful…
but God’s holiness still matters.
The story raises a hard question:
Can great leaders still face consequences?
📖 Numbers 20:12
Before judging Moses, maybe the better question is:
Do we think obedience matters less once we've served a long time?
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Moses thought his weakness disqualified him.
paragraphs: Moses thought his weakness disqualified him.

He told God,
"I am slow of speech and tongue."
But God didn't cancel the calling.
He answered:

"I will help you speak and will teach you what to say."
— Exodus 4:12
Your insecurity does not intimidate God.

Sometimes the place you feel weakest
is the exact place God will reveal His power.
You are not disqualified.
You are called.

If God is still working in your life,
comment YES 🙏
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Religion says earn it.
paragraphs: Religion says earn it.
Jesus says receive it.
You don’t have to fix yourself before coming to God.
You come to God so He can fix what you can’t.

Jesus didn’t say
“Come when you’re perfect.”
He said,

“Come to me, all who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.”
— Matthew 11:28
You are not rejected.
You are not disqualified.
You are welcomed by grace.
Comment AMEN if you’re grateful for God’s grace.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: When family problems break your heart… God is still near.
paragraphs: When family problems break your heart… God is still near.
Some of the hardest prayers happen in the quiet — sitting alone, tears falling, asking God to fix what feels impossible.
But Scripture reminds us:
“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted.” — Psalm 34:18
If you’re going through family struggles right now, you are not alone. God sees every tear and hears every prayer.
Healing may take time, but God is already working behind the scenes.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Daniel worked under King Nebuchadnezzar.
paragraphs:
Daniel worked under King Nebuchadnezzar.
He learned their language.
He served in government.
He carried excellence.
But he refused defilement.

He worked in Babylon.
He didn’t become Babylon.
“But Daniel resolved not to defile himself…” — Daniel 1:8

Government position ≠ spiritual surrender.
Cultural understanding ≠ cultural absorption.

The real tension isn’t visibility.
It’s loyalty.
“How much adaptation is too much?”

Can you stay biblical
and still be culturally relevant?
Or does relevance always demand surrender?
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: You may remember the mistakes.
paragraphs:
You may remember the mistakes.
The shame.
The moments you wish you could erase.
But heaven tells a different story.

Through Jesus, you are forgiven.
Through Jesus, you are redeemed.

Your past may explain you,
but it no longer defines you.
Your story didn’t end in sin.
It ends in grace.
📖 “In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins.” — Ephesians 1:7
If this reminded you who you are in Christ,
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: WHEN YOU CAN’T STAND… GOD STILL CAN.
paragraphs: WHEN YOU CAN’T STAND… GOD STILL CAN.

Sometimes the hardest race in life isn’t against others.
It’s against the voice inside you saying “You failed.”

But God never asked you to be perfect.
He asked you to trust Him.
Your weakest moment may become the place where God shows His greatest strength.

📖 “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.”
— 2 Corinthians 12:9
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: The enemy wants you to feel alone.
paragraphs: The enemy wants you to feel alone.
But heaven calls you family.

Scripture
John 1:12

The enemy whispers:
"You don't belong anywhere."
But God says something different.
"To all who received Him, He gave the right to become children of God." — John 1:12

You are not abandoned.
You are not forgotten.
You are God’s child.
You belong to the family of heaven.
Someone on your list needs this reminder today.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: He commanded soldiers.
paragraphs:
He commanded soldiers.
But he recognized when he was standing in front of Someone greater.
What kind of strength knows when to submit?

Real authority doesn’t compete.
It recognizes.

Matthew 8 shows us something rare —
power that kneels without losing strength.

The centurion didn’t need Jesus to come to his house.
He understood authority.

Some people need proof.
Others recognize presence.
Different levels.
“True strength doesn’t shout. It recognizes.”
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: When everything falls apart… God is not finished.
paragraphs: When everything falls apart… God is not finished.
Sometimes God allows storms to tear down the things we were never meant to build our lives on.
But when the clouds clear, something powerful happens:
A new path appears.
📖 “See, I am doing a new thing!” — Isaiah 43:19
If you're walking through a season where life feels broken… hold on.
God may be preparing a beginning you never imagined.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: The world says “follow your heart.”
paragraphs: The world says “follow your heart.”
But the Bible says your heart is deceitful (Jeremiah 17:9).
Jesus never told anyone to trust their feelings.
He said:
“Follow me.”
Big difference.

One leads to self.
The other leads to salvation.
Look up Luke 9:23.
Everyone says:
“Just follow your heart.”
But… what if your heart is wrong?
Jesus didn’t say follow your heart.
He said follow Me.
That changes everything.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: “Tax collector.
paragraphs:
“Tax collector.
Traitor.
Unclean.”
That’s what they called him.
But Jesus saw something no one else saw.

While the religious leaders guarded their reputations,
Jesus called the man everyone else rejected.
Grace has always offended the self-righteous.
Because mercy doesn’t follow human approval.

Sometimes the person everyone despises
is the one God is about to transform.

Scripture:
Luke 5:31–32

Before we judge someone’s past…
remember who Jesus chose.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: What if the reason you feel unqualified…
paragraphs:
What if the reason you feel unqualified…
is because God chose you?
Jeremiah felt the same fear.

Too young.
Too inexperienced.
Too unsure.
But God said something that changes everything.

"Before I formed you in the womb I knew you."
— Jeremiah 1:5
You are not random.
You are not an accident.
You are appointed.
God saw your purpose before your first breath.
Who needed this tonight?
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: "See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands."
paragraphs:
"See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands."
— Isaiah 49:16

Maybe people overlooked you.
Maybe you feel invisible.
Maybe it seems like your prayers disappeared into silence.
But God says something different.

You are not overlooked.
You are not forgotten.
Your name is written where He will never lose it.

Engraved.
Permanent.
Remembered by God.

Identity Truth:
You are remembered by your Father.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: You weren’t meant to carry everything.
paragraphs: You weren’t meant to carry everything.
Stress, pressure, expectations, responsibilities…
Sometimes life feels like carrying a bag of stones up a mountain.
But God never asked you to carry the weight of life alone.

The moment you surrender the burden,
His strength begins to replace your weakness.

“My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness.”
— 2 Corinthians 12:9
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: Matthew was hated.
paragraphs:
Matthew was hated.
Corrupt.
Rejected by his own people.
No one saw value in him.

But Jesus walked past the crowd…
looked straight at Matthew…
and said two words:
“Follow Me.”
Matthew 9:9

Your past didn't scare God away.
Your mistakes didn't cancel your calling.
Jesus still chooses people the world disqualifies.
You are not your past.
You are chosen.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: God loves using the people the world overlooks.
paragraphs: God loves using the people the world overlooks.

The unqualified.
The doubting.
The ones who feel like they’re not enough.
Why?
Because when God works through someone the world counted out…
His power gets the glory.

You may feel unprepared.
But if God called you, He will equip you.
You are chosen for a purpose.
1 Corinthians 1:27
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: The church feared Saul.
paragraphs: The church feared Saul.

He hunted believers.
Approved executions.
Thought he was defending God.
Then Jesus met him on the road.

The persecutor became the preacher.
The enemy became the apostle.
Sometimes the person we write off…
…is the person God is about to transform.
📖 1 Timothy 1:15
“Do you believe the worst people can truly change?”
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: The future can look terrifying.
paragraphs: The future can look terrifying.

Storm clouds of uncertainty…
Questions without answers…
Paths you cannot see yet.
But God made you a promise.
“The Lord himself goes before you.” — Deuteronomy 31:8

That means the future you're afraid of…
God is already there.

The storm may be loud,
but the sunrise is coming.
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)
